object_description: two-story rectangular building with a fragmented multi-gabled roof
design_condition: The building is positioned along the site edge in balance with the existing ensemble, preserving much of the tree structure and maintaining the established address while opening a peripheral public route.

positive.statement: The space-forming placement harmonizes with the existing buildings and retains the garden-monument structure.
The careful design responds appropriately to school and leisure uses.
The handling of the protected ensemble is cautious and appropriate.
The simple construction supports internal floor-plan flexibility.
The compact building offers prerequisites for good economic indicators.

negative.statement: The placement is unconvincing beside the residential development.
The five-gabled roof creates unnecessary small scale and weakens the expression.
Orientation is difficult and the multi-purpose rooms are not easy to find.
The central upper-floor area is too small and overloaded with functions.
The basement gymnasium lacks a visual connection to the outside space.
The arrangement of eight classes on one floor lacks a connection to the ground floor and cannot meet school requirements.
